S0103b.or: Deus qui beátæ Zedíslavæ concédere dignátus es, ut te júgiter erécta mente contemplarétur, únaque próximo sollícite prospíceret: ea intercedénte, fac nos diligénti stúdio cæléstibus insístere; et caritátem piis opéribus exercére: Per Dóminum.
S0103b.se: Oblátum tibi Dómine sacrifícium, intercedénte beáta Zedíslava, vivíficet nos semper et múniat. Per Dóminum.
S0103b.pc: Hæc nos, quǽsumus Dómine, commúnio sancta lætíficet: qua beátæ Zedíslavæ suffrágiis virtútes roboréntur in córdibus; et actus sanctæ operatiónis excréscant: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who were pleased to grant to blessed Zedislava that she should ever contemplate You with uplifted mind and at the same time care diligently for her neighbor; at her intercession make us apply ourselves with earnest zeal to heavenly things, and exercise charity in works of piety
en.se: May the sacrifice offered to You, O Lord, through the prayer of blessed Zedislava, ever quicken and defend us
en.pc: May this holy communion give us joy, we beseech You, O Lord; whereby through the prayers of blessed Zedislava virtues may be strengthened in our hearts, and our deeds of holiness may increase

S0217b.or: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui beátum Confessórem tuum Regináldum singulári sanctíssimæ Genitrícis tuæ protectióne donásti: illíus nobis méritis et précibus concéde; ut ejúsdem gloriósæ semper Vírginis Maríæ perpétuo muniámur auxílio: Qui vivis.
S0217b.se: Adésto supplicatiónibus nostris miséricors Deus: ut hæc oblátio salutáris in honórem beáti Confessóris tui Regináldi exhíbita, ad úberem grátiam tuam nobis impetrándam, in odórem suavitátis ascéndat. Per Dóminum.
S0217b.pc: Ineffabílibus refécti sacraméntis, quǽsumus clementíssime Jesu, intercedénte beáto Regináldo Confessóre tuo, ab omni nos ánimæ et córporis infirmitáte custódi: ut divíni óperis fructum propénsius exsequéntes; in ætérnam íngredi réquiem festinémus: Qui vivis.

en.or: Almighty, everlasting God, who endowed blessed Reginald, Your confessor, with the singular protection of Your most holy Mother; grant us by his merits and prayers, that we may be ever defended by the help of the same glorious ever-Virgin Mary
en.se: Be near to our prayers, O God of mercy, that this life-giving offering, made in honor of Your blessed confessor Reginald, may rise as an odor of sweetness to win for us Your plenteous grace
en.pc: Refreshed by these ineffable sacraments, we beseech You, most merciful Jesus, at the intercession of blessed Reginald, Your confessor, keep us from every infirmity of soul and body; that, pursuing more readily the fruit of this divine work, we may hasten to enter into eternal rest

S0228b.or: Deus, qui beátam Villánam fámulam tuam a mundi illécebris revocátam, per omnes pœniténtiæ et humilitátis sémitas transíre fecísti: illíus intercessióne concéde; ut reátus nostri conféssio indulgéntiam tuam váleat inveníre: Per Dóminum.
S0228b.se: Beátæ Villánæ memóriam recoléntes, acceptábile fiat sacrifícium, quod tibi offérimus Dómine Deus, ut delictórum nostrórum véniam percípere mereámur. Per Dóminum.
S0228b.pc: Cæléstibus refécti delíciis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut intercedénte beáta Villána, a peccatórum néxibus solúti, et grátiæ tuæ ubertáte repléti; tibi semper adhæreámus: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who called back blessed Villana, Your handmaid, from the allurements of the world, and made her pass along all the paths of penance and humility; grant by her intercession that the confession of our guilt may find Your pardon
en.se: While we call to mind the memory of blessed Villana, may this sacrifice which we offer to You, O Lord our God, be acceptable; that we may deserve to obtain the pardon of our transgressions
en.pc: Refreshed by these heavenly delights, we pray You, almighty God, that through the intercession of blessed Villana we, being loosed from the bonds of sin and filled with the fullness of Your grace, may cleave forever to You

S0304.or: Deus, qui inter regáles delícias, et mundi illécebras sanctum Casimírum virtúte constántiæ roborásti: quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne fidéles tui terréna despíciant; et ad cæléstia semper aspírent: Per Dóminum.
S0304.se: Laudis tibi Dómine hóstias immolámus in tuórum commemoratióne Sanctórum: quibus nos et præséntibus éxui malis confídimus, et futúris. Per Dóminum.
S0304.pc: Refécti cibo potúque cælésti, Deus noster, te súpplices exorámus: ut in cujus hæc commemoratióne percépimus; ejus muniámur et précibus: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who by the virtue of steadfastness strengthened Saint Casimir amidst royal delights and worldly allurements; grant, we beseech You, that by his intercession Your faithful may scorn the things of earth and ever aspire to the things of heaven
en.se: We offer You, O Lord, victims of praise in memory of Your saints; and trust thereby to be freed from all ills both present and to come
en.pc: Refreshed with this heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly pray that we may be helped by the prayers of him in whose memory we have received it

S0317.or: Deus, qui ad prædicándam géntibus glóriam tuam, beátum Patrícium Confessórem atque Pontíficem míttere dignátus es: ejus méritis et intercessióne concéde; ut quæ nobis agénda prǽcipis, te miseránte adimplére possímus: Per Dóminum.
S0317.se: Sancti tui, quǽsumus Dómine, nos ubíque lætíficent: ut dum eórum mérita recólimus, patrocínia sentiámus. Per Dóminum.
S0317.pc: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut de percéptis munéribus grátias exhibéntes; intercedénte beáto Patrício Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, benefícia potióra sumámus: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who were pleased to send forth blessed Patrick, confessor and bishop, to preach Your glory among the Gentiles; grant, through his merits and intercession, that what You command us to do, we may by Your mercy be able to accomplish
en.se: Let Your saints, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we remember their merits we may experience their help
en.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that giving thanks for the gifts received, we may, through the intercession of blessed Patrick, Your confessor and bishop, obtain still greater benefits

S0320b.or: Ecclésiam tuam, Deus, beáti Ambrósii Confessóris tui solémnitas votíva lætíficet: ut spirituálibus semper muniátur auxíliis; et gáudiis pérfrui mereátur ætérnis: Per Dóminum.
S0320b.se: Præsens oblátio fiat, Dómine, pópulo tuo salutáris, pro quo dignátus es Patri tuo te vivéntem hóstiam immoláre: Qui cum eódem Deo Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivis et regnas Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
S0320b.pc: Divínis, Dómine, munéribus satiáti; quǽsumus, ut beáti Ambrósii Confessóris tui méritis gloriósis, salutáris víctimæ desiderátum sentiámus efféctum: Per Dóminum.

en.or: May the hallowed feast of blessed Ambrose, Your confessor, gladden Your Church, O God; that she may be ever defended by spiritual help, and made worthy to enjoy everlasting joys
en.se: May the present offering become life-giving to Your people, O Lord, for whom You were pleased to offer Yourself to Your Father as a living victim: who with the same God the Father and the Holy Spirit live and reign God, world without end.
en.pc: Filled with Your divine gifts, O Lord, we pray that through the glorious merits of blessed Ambrose, Your confessor, we may feel the desired effect of the saving victim

S0610b.or: Deus largítor caritátis: qui beátum Joánnem Confessórem atque Pontíficem in conservánda Ecclésiæ unitáte, instaurandáque regulári disciplína virtúte roborásti; per ipsíus intercessiónem tríbue nobis idípsum sentíre et fácere in Christo Jesu Dómino nostro: Qui tecum.
S0610b.se: Per ipsam immaculátam hóstiam, quam tibi Dómine offérimus, concéde, ut intercedénte beáto Joánne Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, fidem et pacem servémus júgiter in Christo Jesu Dómino nostro: Qui tecum vivit.
S0610b.pc: Largíre benígnus in nobis, Dómine: ut hujus sacrifícii partícipes effécti; per mérita beáti Joánnis Confessóris atque Pontíficis, omnis boni grátiam in præsénti, et ætérnæ retributiónis prǽmium tríbuas in futúro: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, the giver of charity, who strengthened blessed John, Your confessor and bishop, with power to preserve the unity of the Church and to restore regular discipline; grant us by his intercession to be of one mind and to act as one in Christ Jesus our Lord
en.se: Through this unblemished victim which we offer You, O Lord, grant at the prayer of blessed John, Your confessor and bishop, that we may ever preserve faith and peace in Christ Jesus our Lord
en.pc: Be bountiful towards us, O Lord, that we who have been made partakers of this sacrifice may, through the merits of blessed John, Your confessor and bishop, receive from You the grace of every good thing in this present life and the reward of eternal recompense in the life to come

S0622b.or: Deus, qui beátum Innocéntium Confessórem atque Pontíficem, sciéntiæ ac prudéntiæ donis decorátum, pacis et unitátis conciliatórem effecísti: ejus intercessióne nobis concéde cæléstia sápere; et ómnia bona concórdi stúdio sectári: Per Dóminum.
S0622b.se: Præsénti oblatióne, Dómine, atque beáti Innocéntii Pontíficis et Confessóris intercessióne propitiátus, fidélibus tuis pacis et unitátis dona largíre: Per Dóminum.
S0622b.pc: Hujus, Dómine, Sacraménti percéptio, beáto Innocéntio Pontífice et Confessóre intercedénte, quǽsumus; ut salútem et pacem in nobis operétur ætérnam: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who adorned blessed Innocent, Your confessor and bishop, with the gifts of knowledge and prudence, and made him a maker of peace and unity; grant us by his intercession to relish the things of heaven, and to pursue all good things with one mind
en.se: Appeased by this present offering, O Lord, and by the prayers of blessed Innocent, bishop and confessor, bestow on Your faithful the gifts of peace and unity
en.pc: We beseech You, O Lord, by the intercession of blessed Innocent, bishop and confessor, that the receiving of this sacrament may work in us eternal health and peace

S0703_2.or: Deus, qui beátum Leónem Pontíficem, Sanctórum tuórum méritis coæquásti: concéde propítius, ut qui commemoratiónis ejus festa percólimus; vitæ quoque imitémur exémpla: Per Dóminum.
S0703_2.se: Annue nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, ut intercessióne beáti Leónis hæc nobis prosit oblátio, quam immolándo totíus mundi tribuísti relaxári delícta. Per Dóminum.
S0703_2.pc: Deus, qui ánimæ fámuli tui Leónis ætérnæ beatitúdinis prǽmia contulísti: concéde propítius, ut qui peccatórum nostrórum póndere prémimur; ejus apud te précibus sublevémur: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who made blessed Leo, the pontiff, equal in merit to Your saints; grant in Your mercy that we who keep the feast of his commemoration may also follow the example of his life
en.se: Grant us, we pray You, O Lord, that through the intercession of blessed Leo this offering may profit us, by whose immolation You have granted the sins of the whole world to be loosed
en.pc: O God, who bestowed on the soul of Your servant Leo the rewards of eternal blessedness; mercifully grant that we who are weighed down by the burden of our sins may be raised up by his prayers before You

S0707b.or: Deus, qui beátum Benedíctum Pontíficem tuum benedictiónis tuæ grátia sublevásti ad cælum: pópulum tuum, quǽsumus, nova benedictióne grátiæ tuæ sanctífica; et a cunctis malis imminéntibus, ejus méritis et précibus, tua nos virtúte defénde: Per Dóminum.
S0707b.se: Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo Dómine nostra devótio: ut ejus nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro cujus solemnitáte defértur. Per Dóminum.
S0707b.pc: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus tuis, Sanctórum tuórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who by the grace of Your blessing raised up blessed Benedict, Your pontiff, to heaven; sanctify Your people, we beseech You, with a new blessing of Your grace, and by his merits and prayers defend us by Your power from all evils that threaten
en.se: May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, that it may profit us for salvation through the pleading of him on whose feast it is offered
en.pc: Grant to Your faithful, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints, and to be fortified by their unceasing prayer

S0713b.or: Deus, qui beátum Jacóbum Confessórem atque Pontíficem, exímium veritátis præcónem, et pacis conciliatórem effecísti: ejus nobis intercessióne concéde, ut pacem et veritátem diligámus; et ad te, in quo pax summa est, et pura véritas, perveniámus: Per Dóminum.
S0713b.se: Accépta sit in conspéctu tuo Dómine nostra devótio: ut ejus nobis fiat supplicatióne salutáris, pro cujus solemnitáte defértur. Per Dóminum.
S0713b.pc: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus tuis, Sanctórum tuórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who made blessed James, Your confessor and bishop, an outstanding herald of the truth and a maker of peace; grant us by his intercession to love peace and truth, and to come to You, in whom is perfect peace and pure truth
en.se: May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, that it may profit us for salvation through the pleading of him on whose feast it is offered
en.pc: Grant to Your faithful, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints, and to be fortified by their unceasing prayer

S0717b.or: Deus, qui beátum Cesláum, virgíneo morum candóre prǽditum, et salútis animárum zelo succénsum, in divérsis natiónum pópulis óperum sanctitáte, et fídei propagatióne mirábilem effecísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne simus semper in fide stábiles; et ad te, qui solus es ætérnæ salútis auctor et largítor, misericórdiæ tuæ múnere perveníre valeámus: Per Dóminum.
S0717b.se: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum.
S0717b.pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Cesláo Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who made blessed Ceslaus, endowed with virginal purity of life and on fire with zeal for the salvation of souls, wonderful among the peoples of many nations by the holiness of his works and the spreading of the faith; grant, we beseech You, that by his intercession we may ever be steadfast in the faith, and by the gift of Your mercy may come to You, who alone are the author and giver of eternal salvation
en.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You for the honor of Your saints, and may cleanse us in body and mind alike
en.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food may, through the intercession of blessed Ceslaus, Your confessor, be defended by it against all adversity

S0730b.or: Deus, qui beátum Mannem Confessórem tuum, dispositióne mirábili in viam perfectiónis traduxísti: eádem misericórdiæ grátia dírige actus nostros; ut possímus quǽrere quod jubes, et ássequi quod promíttis: Per Dóminum.
S0730b.se: Deus, qui per beátum Mannem immaculátam hóstiam benígne suscípere dignátus es: per mérita ejúsdem hæc, quam tibi hódie offérimus, sit nobis propitiatória ad salútem. Per Dóminum.
S0730b.pc: Deus, qui beátum Mannem cumuláta glória coronásti: per hujus suscépti sacrifícii virtútem tríbue nobis ita pie vívere in terris; ut cum eo coronári mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who by a wonderful disposition led blessed Mannes, Your confessor, into the way of perfection; by the same grace of Your mercy direct our actions, that we may seek what You command and attain what You promise
en.se: O God, who were graciously pleased to receive the spotless victim through blessed Mannes; through his merits may this victim which we offer You today avail us for salvation
en.pc: O God, who crowned blessed Mannes with abundant glory; by the power of this sacrifice which we have received, grant us so to live devoutly on earth that we may deserve to be crowned with him in heaven

S0808b.or: Deus, qui beátæ Joánnæ fámulæ tuæ grátiam supérnæ vocatiónis fílii sui Domínici mirabíliter ostendísti: quǽsumus, ut ipsam, præmonstratúmque fílium imitántes; pio utriúsque intervéntu ætérna prǽmia consequámur: Per Dóminum.
S0808b.se: Deus, in cujus conspéctu hæc, quam offérimus, hóstia placábilis semper appáret: largíre, ut per beátæ Joánnæ méritum, filiíque Domínici, propitiatória sit nobis ad salútem. Per Dóminum.
S0808b.pc: Cælésti pasti dulcédine, ineffábilem tuam Deus exorámus cleméntiam; ut hæc hóstia, intercedéntibus méritis beátæ Joánnæ, ac sancti fílii sui Domínici, sit nobis ablútio scélerum, grátiæ participátio, ac prǽmii ætérni consecútio: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who wonderfully showed to blessed Joan, Your handmaid, the grace of the heavenly calling of her son Dominic; grant, we beseech You, that imitating her and the son foreshown to her, we may by the loving intercession of both attain eternal rewards
en.se: O God, in whose sight this victim which we offer is ever pleasing; grant that through the merit of blessed Joan and of her son Dominic it may avail us for salvation
en.pc: Fed with heavenly sweetness, we implore Your ineffable mercy, O God, that by the merits and intercession of blessed Joan and of her holy son Dominic, this victim may be for us the cleansing of our sins, a share in grace, and the attainment of the eternal reward

S0906b_2.or: Deus, qui sancto Patriárchæ Domínico beátum Bertrándum Confessórem tuum, sócium et imitatórem exímium adjunxísti: ejus nobis pio intervéntu concéde, ita ejúsdem sequi vestígia; ut assequámur et prǽmia: Per Dóminum.
S0906b_2.se: Sacrifícium nostrum, quǽsumus Dómine, beáti Bertrándi Confessóris tui intercéssio sancta comméndet: ut quam ipse in eo offeréndo noxárum véniam pro peccatóribus júgiter implorábat, facílius nos ejus méritis a tua misericórdia impetrémus. Per Dóminum.
S0906b_2.pc: Quos cælésti récreas alimónia, clementíssime Deus, beáti Bertrándi Confessóris tui extólle præsídio: ut inter ómnia adversántis mundi perícula, et devóti tibi permáneant; et secúri consístant: Per Dóminum.

en.or: O God, who joined to the holy patriarch Dominic blessed Bertrand, Your confessor, as his companion and outstanding imitator; grant us by his loving intercession so to follow in his footsteps that we may also attain his rewards
en.se: May the holy intercession of blessed Bertrand, Your confessor, commend our sacrifice to You, we beseech You, O Lord; that the pardon of offenses which he unceasingly implored for sinners in offering it, we may the more readily obtain from Your mercy by his merits
en.pc: Those whom You refresh with heavenly food, most merciful God, raise up by the protection of blessed Bertrand, Your confessor; that amid all the dangers of a hostile world they may remain devoted to You and stand secure
